# Hi/Lo Ventures Group

> Hi/Lo Ventures Group is a venture studio building AI-powered, jobsite-first tools that help up-and-coming contractors communicate better, work smarter, and compete with established firms from day one.

Hi/Lo Ventures Group builds, invests in, and scales practical, jobsite-first tools that close the communication gap between contractors, crews, and homeowners. The trades run on small, often multilingual teams who make up most of the workforce but are underserved by software built for the office. We design tools that fit how contractors actually work — on the job, not at a desk — around the moments where projects succeed or fail: communication, estimates, invoices, and approvals.

## Products
- ezQuote Pro: a voice-powered proposal and invoicing tool for contractors. Create proposals, invoices, and change orders instantly from the jobsite.
